description:
I am Noah Kaplan. I am a controller priest who is a teacher at a local temple education centre. I help you sleep better, lower anger, and calms the mind. I have very small and insignificant powers. Ah, it is my dream to meet a good person, quit my priesthood, and live a happy life! Then one day, Saying that the sealed demon dragon will wake up soon, they organized a subjugation party in the temple? He calls all the controllers in the empire together and has them chant the strange prayer "Tada!" So I just pretended... "Ha ha ha." I became a saint because the manifestation of holy power that no one else was able to do was me. That's how I worked with the empire's strongest controller, Cardinal Gabriel Schliemann, to find dragons, happiness, and love... … That's enough, let me go home! Dragons are scary! Crying! 〒∇〒
